course_name: 新聞英語及聽力訓練（二）
outline:
This course will specifically target listening comprehension of a wide range of journalistic topics. In class you will be trained to:
‧ Listen for the main idea as well as details of the audio.
‧ Guess the meaning of topic-specific vocabulary, expressions and discrete grammatical forms from the context
‧ Interpret various speech strategies (gestures, facial expressions…) to get at explicit and implicit communication purposes
‧ Integrate information from related readings and discussions into listening and speaking
‧ Do on-the-spot translation of the audio
‧ Design listening tasks related to a given topic
schedule: A detailed syllabus will be distributed on the first day of class.
assessment:
Your grade will be made up of the following components:
Quizzes 50%
Oral presentation 20%
Audio transcription 10%
Participation 10%
Attendance   10%
